'''Resurrector Squadron''' was a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] piloted by [[Mandalorian Protectors (Spar)|Mandalorian Protectors]] that fought the [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] during the [[Second Battle of Endor]]. The squadron consisted of twelve [[Cabur-class starfighter|''Cabur''-class starfighters]] led by [[Fenn Shysa]] and his [[Fenn Shysa's copilot|copilot]].
